lonely: Connecting with others is important. Try reaching out to a friend or loved one and share how you're feeling.
anxious: Slow, deep breaths can reduce anxiety. Mindfulness practices have been shown to help calm racing thoughts.
angry: Pausing to reflect before reacting may ease anger. Journaling or a calming activity can help process these feelings.
sad: It's okay to feel sad. Consider talking with someone you trust or engaging in an activity you enjoy to lift your mood.
